heard: But talks in Islamabad failed, and on April 13, a U.S. naval blockade of Iran's ports took  effect.
said: But talks in Islamabad failed, and on April thirteenth, a US naval blockade of Iran's ports took effect.

heard: On April 21st, the ceasefire was extended with no end date.
said: On April twenty-first, the ceasefire was extended, with no end date.

heard: In May, the US struck Iran twice more and called it self-defense.
said: In May, the US struck Iran twice more, and called it "self-defense."

heard: and the deal was always almost done.
said: And the deal was always almost done.

heard: May 23rd, details will be announced shortly.
said: May twenty-third. Details "will be announced shortly."

heard: June 1st, an agreement over the next week.
said: June first. An agreement, "over the next week."

heard: June 9th, signing could be in two or three days.
said: June ninth. Signing "could be in two or three days."

heard: Bitcoin didn't wait for it. From May 31st to June 2nd, it fell more than 9%.
said: Bitcoin didn't wait for it. From May thirty-first to June second, it fell more than nine percent.
By June thirtieth, it was at fifty-eight thousand five hundred.

heard: June 17th.  Finally, a signed paper, the Islamabad Memorandum with 60 days to negotiate.
said: June seventeenth. Finally, a signed paper. The Islamabad Memorandum, with sixty days to negotiate.

heard: The next day, the U.S. ended the blockade and Hormuz reopened.
said: The next day, the US ended the blockade, and Hormuz reopened.

heard: By early July, oil had slid below $70.
said: By early July, oil had slid below seventy dollars.

heard: For three weeks, it looked over.
said: For three weeks, it looked over.
